instruction: A candid street photograph, full-body shot of two friends walking side-by-side down a narrow outdoor alleyway with textured pink and blue walls. On the left, the woman with a dark ponytail and headband (R1) wears a white striped pullover, denim shorts, and striped knee-high socks, smiling as she looks at her companion. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair in a denim jacket (R2) wears a white t-shirt, rolled-up jeans, and teal sneakers, smiling back. Both women walk forward while holding glass bottles in their hands. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
elements: R1 is the dark-ponytailed woman with a headband who smiles while looking at R2
R2 is the curly-brown-haired woman in a denim jacket who smiles back at R1
R1 and R2 walk forward side-by-side as companions
